name: lpi-accelerator-factory
description: Factory skills for the Salesforce Public Sector LPI Accelerator: turn customer requirements into a tailored extension on one managed base product with editable unmanaged baseline workflows. Includes generate-implementation, incremental delta-add, an org API-name resolver, per-client module scoping, add-on license detection, a permit-type content library, and a test-first quality gate (lpi-test) asserting must-have basics and running Apex+Jest before deploy.
